## Why choose Bio Atoms as your business partner ?

## Our Cosmetic Manufacturing Products Process

Our cosmetic manufacturing products process includes several phases, including the conception of a
new product idea (Understanding Requirements), formulation, manufacturing, and packaging. In the
formulation phase, the scientists develop the top-quality ingredients to be used in the final
product. During manufacturing, they carefully follow procedures to ensure that the product is
consistent and meets the desired specifications. Packaging also plays an essential role in the final
product, as it must be functional, aesthetically pleasing, and brand appropriate.

.

attractive products but also about building lasting relationships with our business partners. We
believe in empowering our partners to launch their quality brands, and we are dedicated to providing

# **Our Family Business Dates to 1938.**

# ***You Can Trust Us!***

 

**A little bit about us: In 1938, our great-grandfather and grandfather started Ball Chain Mfg. Co.,
Inc. in the garage behind their house in the Bronx, New York. We have a history of helping others in
times of need. In World War II, our newly-formed company manufactured parts for the Thunderbolt
fighter plane. ****In 2020, at the request of a local community leader, we formed Bona Fide Masks®
to help address the shortage of PPE.**

**As 4th generation family owned and operated business, our mission is to bring authentic masks to
everyone! We are a trusted U.S. military manufacturer that cares so much about our customers. We are
proud that Bona Fide Masks™ is now the [EXCLUSIVE distributor of  ][37][Powecom ® KN95 products][38]
and [Harley KN95 products][39] in the U.S. and Canada. We are further proud to announce our
distribution partnership with [DemeTech][40], a trusted US mask manufacturer.   **

**Authentic Powecom ® and Harley KN95 masks distributed by Bona Fide Masks® are only available
through this site, [Bonafidemasks.com][41].  Additionally, to strengthen supply chain security and
promote the highest levels of transparency, our company directs or handles all warehousing and
distribution for our Powecom, Demetech and Harley masks. We have dedicated experienced logistics
professionals to this effort so that you can purchase Powecom, Demetech and Harley masks with
confidence. We are also proud to ship Powecom ^{MC }products from our Canadian warehouse.**

**Powecom ® was an FDA authorized mask under the EUA when the EUA was active. **

**When you purchase at Bona Fide Masks you know that you are getting authentic masks that are
distributed by us directly from the manufacturer. **

**We are honored to have our leadership efforts during the pandemic recognized by the [Westchester
County Association][42]. Read our story about how we ****became involved, as featured in
[MAXIM][43]! For our Executive Team's Authenticity Statement [Click Here.][44]**

# Welcome to EPD Australasia

Your trusted source for credible, transparent, and comparable environmental information.

At EPD Australasia, we empower businesses across Australia and New Zealand to measure, communicate,
and improve the environmental performance of their products and services. As the official regional
programme operator of the International EPD System, we provide a robust framework for developing and
publishing Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) — verified documents that transparently report
the environmental impact of products throughout their life cycle.

Whether you’re an industry leader aiming to meet green procurement standards, a manufacturer seeking
to understand and communicate your products’ environmental impact, or a sustainability professional
navigating Scope 1, 2 and 3 carbon or life cycle reporting, EPD Australasia is here to support your
journey toward more sustainable outcomes.

## The Value of an EPD

Having an EPD demonstrates that your company has a genuine commitment to environmental
responsibility and transparency. EPDs are used to quantify and communicate the environmental
credentials of an organisation’s products or services to business customers and consumers.

EPDs are popular for construction-based products, and the use of products with EPDs is recognised
and rewarded in sustainable building, infrastructure and embodied carbon rating schemes such as
[GBCA Green Star][44], [NZGBC Greenstar][45], [IS Rating][46] and [NABERS][47] in Australia and New
Zealand.

EPDs can also be developed for almost any product, and in Australasia, we have EPDs for tissue-based
products, fabrics and even a train! Internationally, EPDs have been published for waste management
services, packaging, food and beverages, solar and wind farms and much more.

EPDs and the underpinning Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) are invaluable tools for companies wishing to
identify and address hotspots in the environmental footprint of their products. If your company is
ISO 14001 certified, the LCA and EPD will greatly assist compliance with the 2017 update to the
standard.

With the release of ISO 20400, the International Standard for Sustainable Procurement, Australasian
EPDs are increasingly helping businesses supplying Australian and New Zealand markets to meet public
and private sustainable procurement and tender requirements.

Procurement professionals and building design teams are increasingly conversant in what EPDs are and
how they can be used in decision-making. They are more frequently being used as a means of a quick
and easy route to choose between different products and services, to achieve corporate and project
objectives and better sustainability outcomes.

# Welcome to EPD Australasia

Your trusted source for credible, transparent, and comparable environmental information.

At EPD Australasia, we empower businesses across Australia and New Zealand to measure, communicate,
and improve the environmental performance of their products and services. As the official regional
programme operator of the International EPD System, we provide a robust framework for developing and
publishing Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) — verified documents that transparently report
the environmental impact of products throughout their life cycle.

Whether you’re an industry leader aiming to meet green procurement standards, a manufacturer seeking
to understand and communicate your products’ environmental impact, or a sustainability professional
navigating Scope 1, 2 and 3 carbon or life cycle reporting, EPD Australasia is here to support your
journey toward more sustainable outcomes.

## [View & Search EPDs][43]

## The Value of an EPD

Having an EPD demonstrates that your company has a genuine commitment to environmental
responsibility and transparency. EPDs are used to quantify and communicate the environmental
credentials of an organisation’s products or services to business customers and consumers.

EPDs are popular for construction-based products, and the use of products with EPDs is recognised
and rewarded in sustainable building, infrastructure and embodied carbon rating schemes such as
[GBCA Green Star][44], [NZGBC Greenstar][45], [IS Rating][46] and [NABERS][47] in Australia and New
Zealand.

EPDs can also be developed for almost any product, and in Australasia, we have EPDs for tissue-based
products, fabrics and even a train! Internationally, EPDs have been published for waste management
services, packaging, food and beverages, solar and wind farms and much more.

EPDs and the underpinning Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) are invaluable tools for companies wishing to
identify and address hotspots in the environmental footprint of their products. If your company is
ISO 14001 certified, the LCA and EPD will greatly assist compliance with the 2017 update to the
standard.

With the release of ISO 20400, the International Standard for Sustainable Procurement, Australasian
EPDs are increasingly helping businesses supplying Australian and New Zealand markets to meet public
and private sustainable procurement and tender requirements.

Procurement professionals and building design teams are increasingly conversant in what EPDs are and
how they can be used in decision-making. They are more frequently being used as a means of a quick
and easy route to choose between different products and services, to achieve corporate and project
objectives and better sustainability outcomes.

# Face Mask Manufacturer in China for Custom and Bulk Orders

THNE MASK operates as a direct manufacturer of disposable civil face masks and disposable medical
face masks in Beiyuan Street, Yiwu, Jinhua, Zhejiang. We support OEM, private label, wholesale, and
repeat bulk supply for importers, distributors, brand owners, and project buyers.

For professional buyers, the decision is never based on price alone. Mask structure, raw material
consistency, production environment, packaging method, loading efficiency, and delivery timing all
affect the final result. Our facility covers more than 4,880 m², including 2,750 m² of clean
production area, 320 m² of quality inspection area, and 1,550 m² of warehouse space, allowing us to
organize production and shipment planning in a more stable way.

We work with customers from more than 20 countries and focus on practical order handling. Support
can include logo printing, inner bag and box design, carton marking, size confirmation, packaging
adjustment, sample review, and shipment arrangement by sea or air according to the order
requirement.

[About THNE MASK][60]

Including 2,750 m² clean production area, 320 m² inspection area, and 1,550 m² warehouse space for
organized production and shipment handling.

### 50+ Employees

Production workers, quality inspectors, warehouse staff, and export sales personnel supporting
custom and wholesale orders together.

### 10–30 Days Production

Lead time depends on product type, order quantity, artwork confirmation, and packaging complexity
rather than unrealistic fixed promises.

### 20+ Export Markets

Serving importers, distributors, medical supply traders, brand owners, and other B2B buyers in more
than 20 countries.

THNE MASK operates as a direct manufacturer of disposable civil face masks and disposable medical
face masks in Beiyuan Street, Yiwu, Jinhua, Zhejiang. We support OEM, private label, wholesale, and
repeat bulk supply for importers, distributors, brand owners, and project buyers.

For professional buyers, the decision is never based on price alone. Mask structure, raw material

We work with customers from more than 20 countries and focus on practical order handling. Support
can include logo printing, inner bag and box design, carton marking, size confirmation, packaging

### 4,880+ m² Facility

## Surgical Masks

For surgical mask projects, we focus on clear product structure, controlled production, and

public supply channels usually need packaging, paperwork, and specification to be aligned before
mass production starts.

## N95 Masks & KN95 Masks

This category is intended for buyers sourcing higher-filtration protective mask projects. Product
selection in this range should always be confirmed by model, specification, target market, and
required documentation. For OEM and bulk orders, we suggest finalizing application, packaging
method, and shipment plan at an early stage.
[[NIOSH Approved N95 Mask Particulate Respirators Pack of 20 Individually Wrapped Universal Fit
Benehal 8225]][84]

### [Spot KN95 Disposable Protective Mask | Comfortable Breathable Safety Face Cover][89]

## Who We Manufacture For

### Importers

Buyers who need stable supply, practical packaging, and clear shipment coordination for repeat
orders.

### Distributors

Businesses that require market-ready packing, manageable MOQ planning, and efficient bulk delivery.

### Private Brands

Customers developing their own logo, box design, barcode system, and carton mark for retail or
online sales.

### Project Buyers

Buyers who need specification confirmation, sample approval, and organized production before
large-volume supply starts.

## Manufacturing and Quality Control

### Material Confirmation Before Production

Before production starts, we confirm mask structure, fabric composition, earloop method, nose wire
requirement, inner packing, and carton plan. This helps the approved sample stay consistent with
bulk production.

### Lead Time Based on Real Order Conditions

Production is commonly arranged within 10 to 30 days depending on mask type, quantity, artwork
confirmation, and packaging complexity. We prefer realistic schedules over generic promises.

### Inspection During and After Production

Inspection is not only done at the end. We check material consistency, appearance, welding quality,
packing accuracy, and carton marking throughout the order process to reduce claim risk after
shipment.

### Warehouse and Shipment Planning

With 1,550 m² warehouse space, we can organize finished goods, export cartons, and consolidated
loading more efficiently. This is especially useful for repeat buyers and mixed-shipment orders.

### Clean Production and Process Control

Our facility includes dedicated clean production space for disposable and medical face mask
manufacturing. Material feeding, forming, welding, folding, packing, and finished goods handling are
arranged for more stable.

### Export-Focused Communication

Our export team focuses on order details that matter in real business, including MOQ, artwork files,
sample review, shipping terms, outer carton marks, and delivery coordination.

## Factory Photos and Documentation

For professional buyers, visual proof and order documentation are as important as product
description. We can support factory photos, workshop images, packing photos, sample confirmation,
and order-related documents based on the specific project and market requirement.

A real manufacturing project starts with a real production environment. Use this position to show
your factory exterior, clean workshop, and line layout.

### Production and Inspection

Use this position to present forming, welding, folding, packing, and inspection photos so buyers can
better understand how the order is handled.
[warehouse]

### Packing and Shipment

Use this position to show warehouse, carton storage, pallet arrangement, container loading, or
shipment preparation photos for export orders.

## Custom Face Mask Service

Our customization service is built for real OEM and wholesale orders. Instead of only changing a
logo, we help buyers confirm the specification and packing logic that will affect cost, appearance,
freight efficiency, and final market presentation.

### Custom Logo Printing

We support logo printing and branded presentation based on product type and packaging plan. For many
buyers, logo work is closely linked with box layout, barcode, carton mark, and final sales channel.

### Custom Colors and Appearance

Standard blue and white are common, but many private label and retail projects also require black,
grey, or other market-oriented options. We help confirm color choice together with packaging and
target positioning.

### Material and Structure Adjustment

Material discussion should be done from a manufacturing point of view. Layer structure, fabric
weight, filtration media, nose wire, and earloop style can all affect performance, appearance, and
production cost.

### Custom Packaging Design

Inner bag count, box quantity, barcode, carton mark, and shipping carton size are often as important
as the mask itself. We support packaging adjustment for wholesale, retail, and project distribution
orders.

### Custom Sizes and Fit

Adult, youth, and children’s projects require clear size confirmation before sampling and
production. We help buyers reduce mismatch risk by confirming dimensions and packaging details at an
early stage.

### Documentation and Order Support

Documentation requirements depend on product type, exact model, packaging, and destination market.
We support buyers in checking the appropriate order details before production is arranged.

## Question and Answer

  filtration media, and inner contact layers. For bulk orders, we suggest confirming structure,
  application, and packaging at the same time.

THNE MASK operates as a direct manufacturer of disposable civil face masks and disposable medical
face masks in Beiyuan Street, Yiwu, Jinhua, Zhejiang. We support OEM, private label, wholesale, and
repeat bulk supply for importers, distributors, brand owners, and project buyers.

For professional buyers, the decision is never based on price alone. Mask structure, raw material
consistency, production environment, packaging method, loading efficiency, and delivery timing all
affect the final result. Our facility covers more than 4,880 m², including 2,750 m² of clean
production area, 320 m² of quality inspection area, and 1,550 m² of warehouse space, allowing us to
organize production and shipment planning in a more stable way.

We work with customers from more than 20 countries and focus on practical order handling. Support
can include logo printing, inner bag and box design, carton marking, size confirmation, packaging
adjustment, sample review, and shipment arrangement by sea or air according to the order

This category is intended for buyers sourcing higher-filtration protective mask projects. Product
selection in this range should always be confirmed by model, specification, target market, and
required documentation. For OEM and bulk orders, we suggest finalizing application, packaging
method, and shipment plan at an early stage.

## Who We Manufacture For

### Importers

Buyers who need stable supply, practical packaging, and clear shipment coordination for repeat
orders.

### Distributors

Businesses that require market-ready packing, manageable MOQ planning, and efficient bulk delivery.

### Private Brands

Customers developing their own logo, box design, barcode system, and carton mark for retail or
online sales.

### Project Buyers

Buyers who need specification confirmation, sample approval, and organized production before
large-volume supply starts.

## Manufacturing and Quality Control

### Material Confirmation Before Production

Before production starts, we confirm mask structure, fabric composition, earloop method, nose wire
requirement, inner packing, and carton plan. This helps the approved sample stay consistent with
bulk production.

### Lead Time Based on Real Order Conditions

Production is commonly arranged within 10 to 30 days depending on mask type, quantity, artwork
confirmation, and packaging complexity. We prefer realistic schedules over generic promises.

### Inspection During and After Production

Inspection is not only done at the end. We check material consistency, appearance, welding quality,
packing accuracy, and carton marking throughout the order process to reduce claim risk after
shipment.

### Warehouse and Shipment Planning

With 1,550 m² warehouse space, we can organize finished goods, export cartons, and consolidated
loading more efficiently. This is especially useful for repeat buyers and mixed-shipment orders.

### Clean Production and Process Control

Our facility includes dedicated clean production space for disposable and medical face mask
manufacturing. Material feeding, forming, welding, folding, packing, and finished goods handling are
arranged for more stable.

### Export-Focused Communication

Our export team focuses on order details that matter in real business, including MOQ, artwork files,
sample review, shipping terms, outer carton marks, and delivery coordination.

## Factory Photos and Documentation

For professional buyers, visual proof and order documentation are as important as product
description. We can support factory photos, workshop images, packing photos, sample confirmation,
and order-related documents based on the specific project and market requirement.

### Packing and Shipment

Use this position to show warehouse, carton storage, pallet arrangement, container loading, or
shipment preparation photos for export orders.

## Custom Face Mask Service

Our customization service is built for real OEM and wholesale orders. Instead of only changing a
logo, we help buyers confirm the specification and packing logic that will affect cost, appearance,
freight efficiency, and final market presentation.

### Custom Logo Printing

We support logo printing and branded presentation based on product type and packaging plan. For many
buyers, logo work is closely linked with box layout, barcode, carton mark, and final sales channel.

### Custom Colors and Appearance

Standard blue and white are common, but many private label and retail projects also require black,
grey, or other market-oriented options. We help confirm color choice together with packaging and
target positioning.

### Material and Structure Adjustment

Material discussion should be done from a manufacturing point of view. Layer structure, fabric
weight, filtration media, nose wire, and earloop style can all affect performance, appearance, and
production cost.

### Custom Packaging Design

Inner bag count, box quantity, barcode, carton mark, and shipping carton size are often as important
as the mask itself. We support packaging adjustment for wholesale, retail, and project distribution
orders.

### Custom Sizes and Fit

Adult, youth, and children’s projects require clear size confirmation before sampling and
production. We help buyers reduce mismatch risk by confirming dimensions and packaging details at an
early stage.

### Documentation and Order Support

Documentation requirements depend on product type, exact model, packaging, and destination market.
We support buyers in checking the appropriate order details before production is arranged.

  filtration media, and inner contact layers. For bulk orders, we suggest confirming structure,
  application, and packaging at the same time.

### Flexible spreadsheets made accessible

It handles everyday spreadsheet needs with confidence, balancing **real-time collaboration**,
**familiar formulas**, and **clear data visualization** that support routine productivity. It works
well for finance tracking, planners & calendars, and light project management without overwhelming
users. While advanced analysts may miss deeper spreadsheet controls, its mix of accessibility and

and very large datasets may feel slower compared to desktop-focused spreadsheet tools built

Google Sheets for Chrome fits comfortably into long-term productivity routines, particularly for
users invested in **cloud storage**, **file sharing**, and collaborative document ecosystems.
Updates are handled seamlessly, and maintenance demands stay minimal. However, reliance on an active
browser session may not appeal to those who prefer offline-first workflows or require highly
specialized spreadsheet features offered by more complex, locally installed alternatives.

### A practical browser spreadsheet

Google Sheets for Chrome remains a strong option for users who prioritize accessibility, real-time
collaboration, and flexible spreadsheet management within a browser-based environment. While it may
not fully replace advanced desktop tools for heavy data processing, it excels at shared tasks,
planning, and everyday organization. For students, teams, and professionals working online, it
continues to serve as a reliable, efficient, and practical productivity companion for modern digital

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.
